title: Sidebar
description: The main menu: logo and product name, groups of Nav items separated by Nav dividers, the Profile card at the foot and the Sidebar toggle on the right edge. Expanded it is 264px; collapsed it is an 80px icon rail, and the width animates between the two. Keep the menu order the product uses; groups only add dividers between neighbours.

grids.title: Widths
grids.note: Width animates 264px to 80px over .24s ease; the brand name fades over .16s.

props.x: 80px icon rail instead of the 264px menu.
